svg.aria-label: Sketchbook page 2, drawn in crayon. Qyudal. One news story fans out to seven agents at once and merges into one analysis, in under 4 seconds instead of 20 to 30 one by one. If Gemini is down, Llama 3.3 still answers.
svg.title: Page 2: Qyudal
svg.desc: Sketchbook page 2, drawn in crayon. Qyudal. One news story fans out to seven agents at once and merges into one analysis, in under 4 seconds instead of 20 to 30 one by one. If Gemini is down, Llama 3.3 still answers.

g.text: Seven LLM agents read one news
story at the same time. If the main
model goes down, a backup keeps
answering. Works on web, iOS and
with Llama 3.3 as fallback, and Firebase
Built with React Native (Expo), Gemini, Groq
